metrics.title: Daily active installs
metrics.purpose: How many installs open an app on a day.
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people; one person on two devices counts twice. A week or month reads as the average day.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.active' AND dim = 'day' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app

metrics.title: Weekly active installs
metrics.purpose: How many installs open an app in an ISO week.
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. Each install reports once per week, so a week still running is a partial count.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.active' AND dim = 'week' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: Monthly active installs
metrics.purpose: How many installs open an app in a calendar month.
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. A month still running is a partial count.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, 'start of month') AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.active' AND dim = 'month' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: Weekly active installs by version
metrics.purpose: Which versions of an app the week's active installs ran, as major.minor, so a release's reach shows.
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. An install counts once a week, under the version it ran when it first opened the app that week; a version the app did not report is unknown.
metrics.sql:
SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app,
  CASE WHEN version_bucket = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE version_bucket END AS dim,
  SUM(count) AS value FROM daily
WHERE event = 'app.active' AND dim = 'week' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, 3

metrics.title: Weekly active installs by platform
metrics.purpose: Which platforms an app's active installs of the week ran on, so the iPhone, iPad and Mac share of a universal app shows.
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. An install counts once a week, under the platform it reported when it first opened the app that week.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, platform AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.active' AND dim = 'week' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, platform

metrics.title: New installs
metrics.purpose: Installs active in the week they were installed, the closest Lifestream gets to downloads that open the app.
metrics.caveat: Only installs that ran a version with Lifestream and left usage counts on. App Store downloads are the downloads metric.

metrics.title: Week-1 retention
metrics.purpose: The share of a week's new installs that are active again the next week.
metrics.caveat: The period is the install week. A cohort under 5 installs is hidden, and the latest cohort has no week 1 yet.

metrics.title: Week-4 retention
metrics.purpose: The share of a week's new installs still active four weeks later.
metrics.caveat: The period is the install week. A cohort under 5 installs is hidden, and cohorts younger than four weeks have no value.

metrics.title: Paywall views
metrics.purpose: How often a paywall is seen, by placement.
metrics.caveat: Each install counts once per day per placement.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'paywall.view' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Checkouts
metrics.purpose: What happened when a paywall's buy button was pressed, by outcome.
metrics.caveat: The outcome is the app's view of the purchase; the ledger's purchases are the record of what Apple charged.
metrics.sql:
SELECT day AS period, app,
  CASE WHEN instr(dim, '|') > 0 THEN substr(dim, 1, instr(dim, '|') - 1) ELSE dim END AS dim,
  SUM(count) AS value FROM daily
WHERE event = 'paywall.checkout' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, 3

metrics.title: Paywall purchases
metrics.purpose: Purchases completed in the app.
metrics.caveat: A purchase made on this install, every product it sells, tips included. Builds released before 2026-11-21 also counted every first transaction that reached an install (bought on another device, or handed over by StoreKit after an update), so their values run several times too high; the purchases_agree check compares this with the ledger.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'paywall.purchase' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app

metrics.title: Paywall conversion
metrics.purpose: Purchases per paywall view.
metrics.caveat: Views are once per install per day per placement, so this is purchases per paywall day rather than per showing.

metrics.title: First-run steps
metrics.purpose: How many installs reach each first-run step, once per install.
metrics.caveat: Each install reports a step once in its life, on the day it first reaches it.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'funnel.step' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Portal impressions
metrics.purpose: How often the cross-promotion portal or a contextual overlay shows another Midgar app, by target app and placement.
metrics.caveat: Counts showings, not installs.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event IN ('impression', 'overlay') AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Portal taps
metrics.purpose: Taps on another Midgar app in the portal, by target app and placement.
metrics.caveat: A tap opens the App Store page; the install, if any, is the downloads metric's campaign.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'tap' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Sales
metrics.purpose: App Store sale events as Apple notifies them, by kind.
metrics.caveat: Production only. Kinds are INITIAL_PURCHASE, RENEWAL, NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE, REFUND and REVOCATION as the ledger maps them.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(event_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS period, slug AS app, kind AS dim, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sale_events WHERE environment = 'Production' AND date(event_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

metrics.title: Refunds
metrics.purpose: Purchases Apple refunded or revoked.
metrics.caveat: Production only; the day Apple told the ledger, not the day of the purchase.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(event_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS period, slug AS app, '' AS dim, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sale_events WHERE environment = 'Production' AND kind IN ('REFUND', 'REVOCATION') AND date(event_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: Active subscriptions
metrics.purpose: Subscriptions paid up at the end of each day.
metrics.caveat: Production only, counted from the transactions the ledger has; a subscription bought before the ledger existed counts from its first renewal the ledger saw. Family Sharing copies of a subscription are not counted, only the purchase. Every app that ever sold a subscription has a value for every day, zero included.
metrics.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS (SELECT :since UNION ALL SELECT date(d, '+1 day') FROM days WHERE d < :until), sellers(slug) AS (SELECT DISTINCT slug FROM transactions WHERE environment = 'Production' AND type = 'Auto-Renewable Subscription') SELECT d AS period, s.slug AS app, '' AS dim, COUNT(DISTINCT t.original_transaction_id) AS value FROM days CROSS JOIN sellers s LEFT JOIN transactions t
  ON t.slug = s.slug AND t.environment = 'Production' AND t.type = 'Auto-Renewable Subscription' AND t.revocation_date IS NULL
  AND COALESCE(t.ownership_type, 'PURCHASED') = 'PURCHASED'
  AND t.purchase_date < (unixepoch(d, '+1 day') * 1000) AND t.expires_date >= (unixepoch(d, '+1 day') * 1000)
GROUP BY d, s.slug

metrics.title: Introductory offers started
metrics.purpose: Subscriptions that started on an introductory offer, a free trial in most apps.
metrics.caveat: Production only. Apple's offer type 1 covers free trials and pay-up-front or pay-as-you-go introductory prices alike.
metrics.sql:
SELECT date(purchase_date / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS period, slug AS app, '' AS dim, COUNT(DISTINCT original_transaction_id) AS value FROM transactions WHERE environment = 'Production' AND type = 'Auto-Renewable Subscription' AND offer_type = 1
  AND transaction_id = original_transaction_id AND date(purchase_date / 1000, 'unixepoch') BETWEEN :since AND :until
GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: AI requests
metrics.purpose: Chat requests mako served, by model alias.
metrics.caveat: Chat requests only; image generations are not counted here.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(c.created_at) AS period, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.registry_slug, ''), c.app_id) AS app, c.alias AS dim, COUNT(*) AS value FROM chat_requests c LEFT JOIN apps a ON a.app_id = c.app_id WHERE date(c.created_at) BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

metrics.title: AI images
metrics.purpose: Image generations and edits mako was asked for, by outcome. A day of failed with no ok is a provider outage, which the nightly preflight reports.
metrics.caveat: ok made an image; declined is the model or moderation refusing the request; failed is anything else, a provider outage or billing stop first of all. Before 2026-11-02 mako filed a failed Gemini call under its no-image text, so those rows are told apart by the HTTP error or parse failure they carry.
metrics.sql:
SELECT date(u.created_at) AS period, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.registry_slug, ''), u.app_id) AS app,
  CASE WHEN u.error IS NULL THEN 'ok'
    WHEN u.error LIKE '%moderation%' OR u.error LIKE '%content_policy%' THEN 'declined'
    WHEN u.error LIKE '%No images returned by Gemini%' AND u.error NOT LIKE '%Gemini API error%' AND u.error NOT LIKE '%Failed to parse%' THEN 'declined'
    ELSE 'failed' END AS dim,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM usage_records u LEFT JOIN apps a ON a.app_id = u.app_id WHERE date(u.created_at) BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

metrics.title: Installs that crashed
metrics.purpose: How many installs had a crash on a day.
metrics.caveat: The system reports a crash at the app's next launch, so it is counted on the day it was reported, on iPhone, iPad and Mac only. A fault describes the code, so a count of one is shown.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'health.crashed' AND dim = 'crash' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app

metrics.title: Crash rate
metrics.purpose: The share of a day's active installs that had a crash. One minus this is the crash-free share.
metrics.caveat: Crashes are counted on the day they were reported and actives on the day they happened, so a single day can read above the truth and a week reads better. Only versions that report crashes can have one.

metrics.title: Installs with a fault, by kind
metrics.purpose: How many installs crashed, froze, or were ended by the system for memory or for not responding, by which.
metrics.caveat: An install counts once a day per kind. Memory and watchdog ends come from the system's daily figures, a day late.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'health.crashed' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Installs that hit an error
metrics.purpose: How many installs ran into a failure the app showed or logged, by what failed and why.
metrics.caveat: An install counts once a day per kind of failure, however often it hit it. The dimension is the domain and the code joined by a bar.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'error.hit' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Cold launch time
metrics.purpose: How long a cold start takes to its first frame, as the average of the installs' daily medians.
metrics.caveat: Each install reports the median of its own day, from the system's figures, a day late; this is the average of those. iPhone, iPad and Mac only.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(sum) / SUM(count) AS value FROM daily_measures WHERE event = 'metrics.daily' AND measure = 'coldLaunchMs' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app

metrics.title: Time frozen per hour of use
metrics.purpose: Seconds the app did not respond per hour in the foreground, averaged over the installs that reported.
metrics.caveat: From the system's daily figures, a day late. iPhone, iPad and Mac only.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(sum) / SUM(count) AS value FROM daily_measures WHERE event = 'metrics.daily' AND measure = 'hangSecondsPerHour' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app

metrics.title: Ended for memory while in use
metrics.purpose: How often the system ended an app in the foreground because it used too much memory. Nobody reports these as crashes, and to the person they are one.
metrics.caveat: From the system's daily figures, a day late, on iPhone and iPad only.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(sum) AS value FROM daily_measures WHERE event = 'metrics.exits' AND measure = 'foregroundMemory' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app

metrics.title: Downloads
metrics.purpose: First-time App Store downloads, from Apple's sales reports.
metrics.caveat: Apple's reports arrive a day or two late. Read on the machine that has the Apple report warehouse.

metrics.title: Proceeds
metrics.purpose: What Apple pays out after its commission, from Apple's sales reports.
metrics.caveat: Euro proceeds only; the warehouse keeps every currency apart and never converts, so other currencies are named beside the answer. Apple's reports arrive a day or two late. Read on the machine that has the Apple report warehouse.

metrics.title: App Store impressions
metrics.purpose: How often an app was shown in the App Store, by where it was shown (search, browse, another app or the web).
metrics.caveat: From Apple's Analytics reports, which arrive a day or two late and are restated for three days. Apple leaves out rows too small to share. The dimension is the source.

metrics.title: Product page views
metrics.purpose: How often an app's App Store product page was opened, by source.
metrics.caveat: From Apple's Analytics reports; a person who downloads from a search result never opens the page. Apple leaves out rows too small to share.

metrics.title: First-time downloads by source
metrics.purpose: First-time downloads as Apple's Analytics counts them, by where the person came from.
metrics.caveat: Apple's Analytics count, which can differ by a few from the sales reports the downloads metric reads. Redownloads and updates are left out.

metrics.title: Store conversion
metrics.purpose: First-time downloads per App Store impression.
metrics.caveat: Impressions count showings and downloads count people, so this is downloads per showing, not Apple's own conversion rate, which divides by unique devices.

metrics.title: Installs Apple saw
metrics.purpose: Installs on devices whose owners share analytics with developers.
metrics.caveat: Only people who agreed to share analytics with app developers are counted, so this is a part of all installs and best read as a trend.

metrics.title: Deletions Apple saw
metrics.purpose: How often an app was deleted, on devices whose owners share analytics with developers.
metrics.caveat: Only people who agreed to share analytics with app developers are counted. It is the only place a deletion shows at all.

metrics.title: Sessions Apple saw
metrics.purpose: Times an app was opened for at least two seconds, on devices whose owners share analytics with developers.
metrics.caveat: Only people who agreed to share analytics with app developers are counted. Lifestream's own actives cover everyone who left usage counts on.

metrics.title: Crashes Apple saw
metrics.purpose: Crashes Apple's own diagnostics counted, on every platform including Apple TV and Watch.
metrics.caveat: Only people who agreed to share diagnostics with developers are counted. Lifestream's own crash cards cover iPhone, iPad and Mac with the line of code.

metrics.title: Installs that reached first value
metrics.purpose: How many installs got what the app is for, for the first time, in a week.
metrics.caveat: Each app names one value moment in its registry entry. An install counts once, ever, in the week the moment came. An install that was already in use when its app began reporting counts on its next value moment, so an app's first weeks run high.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'value.first' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: Activation
metrics.purpose: The share of a week's new installs that reached the app's value moment.
metrics.caveat: First-value installs of the week over installs new that week. Nearly every value moment comes in the install week, but a late one counts in its own week, so a single week can pass 1; read several weeks together.

metrics.title: First value by how soon
metrics.purpose: How soon after installing the value moment came, namely in the first session, later on the first day, within the first week or after.
metrics.caveat: A first session is the first run of the app after it was installed, within its first day. The dimension is first_session, day0, week1 or later.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'value.first' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

metrics.title: Installs that used a feature
metrics.purpose: How many installs used each of an app's features in a week.
metrics.caveat: Each app lists up to 16 features in its registry entry, and a feature it does not list counts as other. An install counts once a week per feature.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, CASE WHEN instr(dim, '|') > 0 THEN substr(dim, 1, instr(dim, '|') - 1) ELSE dim END AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'feature.use' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, 3

metrics.title: Installs that used a feature, by tier
metrics.purpose: Which features free, trial, paying and lapsed installs use, so what payers value shows.
metrics.caveat: The dimension is the feature and the tier joined by a bar. The tier is the one the install had the first time it used the feature that week; unknown until its store has answered.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'feature.use' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

metrics.title: Active installs by tier
metrics.purpose: How many of a week's active installs are free, on a trial, paying or lapsed.
metrics.caveat: Free means the install never held an entitlement, lapsed that one ended; an install that only bought credits is free. An install whose store has not answered yet is not counted, so the tiers add up to less than the weekly active installs.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.tier' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

metrics.title: Paying active installs
metrics.purpose: How many of a week's active installs hold a paid entitlement.
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not customers; one customer on two devices counts twice. A free trial is not paying.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.tier' AND dim = 'paid' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: Active installs whose tier is known
metrics.purpose: The week's active installs that reported a tier, the base the paid share is measured on.
metrics.caveat: Only installs on a version that reports tiers, with usage counts on.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.tier' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: Paid share of active installs
metrics.purpose: The share of a week's active installs that pay.
metrics.caveat: Paying installs over installs whose tier is known. Installs, not customers.

metrics.title: Purchases by install age
metrics.purpose: How long the app had been installed when a purchase was made in it.
metrics.caveat: day0 is the first 24 hours, week1 the rest of the first week, month1 up to four weeks, quarter1 up to ninety days, older after that. Sent six to forty-eight hours after it happened and counted one fact at a time, so it cannot be read beside a sale or another breakdown of the same purchases, and the week is the week it arrived.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, substr(dim, 5) AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'purchase.story' AND dim LIKE 'age=%' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, 3

metrics.title: Purchases by placement
metrics.purpose: Where the purchase screen was opened from the last time before a purchase.
metrics.caveat: A purchase with no purchase screen before it, such as one started from the App Store, has no placement and is missing here. Sent six to forty-eight hours after it happened and counted one fact at a time, so it cannot be read beside a sale or another breakdown of the same purchases, and the week is the week it arrived.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, substr(dim, 11) AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'purchase.story' AND dim LIKE 'placement=%' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, 3

metrics.title: Purchase screens seen before buying
metrics.purpose: How many times an install had shown a purchase screen when it bought, the one it bought from included.
metrics.caveat: none, one, two_three, four_nine or ten_plus, counted over the life of the install. Sent six to forty-eight hours after it happened and counted one fact at a time, so it cannot be read beside a sale or another breakdown of the same purchases, and the week is the week it arrived.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, substr(dim, 13) AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'purchase.story' AND dim LIKE 'viewsBefore=%' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, 3

metrics.title: Renewals turned off, by tenure
metrics.purpose: How long a subscription had run when its renewal was turned off.
metrics.caveat: first_month, quarter1 (up to 90 days), half1, year1 or longer. An install tells it once per time the renewal goes off, and an install that updates with a renewal already off tells it then. A renewal turned off outside the app is seen the next time the app is opened. Sent six to forty-eight hours after it happened and counted one fact at a time, so it cannot be read beside a sale or another breakdown of the same purchases, and the week is the week it arrived.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, substr(dim, 8) AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'renewal.off' AND dim LIKE 'tenure=%' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, 3

metrics.title: Renewals turned off, by recent use
metrics.purpose: On how many of the fourteen days before a renewal was turned off the app had been opened.
metrics.caveat: none, one_two, three_six or seven_plus days. Sent six to forty-eight hours after it happened and counted one fact at a time, so it cannot be read beside a sale or another breakdown of the same purchases, and the week is the week it arrived.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, substr(dim, 12) AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'renewal.off' AND dim LIKE 'activeDays=%' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, 3

metrics.title: Installs exposed to an experiment
metrics.purpose: How many installs each version of a running experiment was shown to.
metrics.caveat: The dimension is the experiment and the version joined by a bar. An install counts once per experiment, in the week it first met the screen under test. `midgar lab status` reads the experiment as a whole.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'lab.exposed' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

metrics.title: Installs an experiment converted
metrics.purpose: How many exposed installs went on to the outcome their experiment measures, per version.
metrics.caveat: Counted only when the outcome followed the exposure on the same install, once per experiment. The dimension is the experiment and the version joined by a bar.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'lab.converted' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

checks.title: Purchases the apps report against the ledger's sales
checks.why: A purchase completed in an app and a first sale event in the ledger are the same purchase seen from two sides. The app side can only be lower, since usage counts can be switched off and older versions send nothing.

checks.title: Checkouts that ended in a purchase against purchases
checks.why: Every purchase made at a paywall ends a checkout as purchased and is also sent as a purchase, so the two counts are the same event recorded twice by the same app.
